metadata.description: Glimpse: let a coding agent see what it builds. Renders diagrams, pages and live app windows to PNGs.

plugins.name: glimpse
plugins.description: Render any UI or diagram to a PNG and design clear diagrams — the glimpse render-loop CLI plus the diagram-design skill.

plugins.name: glimpse-drive
plugins.description: Let an agent operate a running desktop app itself — click, type, close dialogs, use the tray, and assert which windows are visible — with the glimpse-drive CLI and the driving-desktop-apps skill; and see and type into a Hyper-V VM's console with the driving-hyperv-consoles skill.
